name: reel-animated-explainer
description: Turn a raw talking-head video into an animated explainer reel with Claude Code and Remotion. Core engine plus swappable theme plugins.

plugins.name: reel-studio
plugins.description: Core engine: transcribe, time captions to speech, plan scenes, render with Remotion, mix music and SFX. Needs at least one theme plugin.

plugins.name: theme-yellow-ticker
plugins.description: Theme: speaker full screen, yellow dotted card with swipe-in scenes, one-line ticker captions, split-flap boards.

plugins.name: theme-lime-bento
plugins.description: Theme: dark grid, lime accents, speaker slides into a bento tile, can split into labelled strips, karaoke captions.

plugins.name: theme-cream-passport
plugins.description: Theme: cream paper, navy and red ink, rubber stamps, speaker shrinks into a framed card, mustard keyword pills.

plugins.name: theme-control-panel
plugins.description: Theme: industrial control panel, speaker in a camera window, schematic board, label-maker captions, breaker switches and trip flashes.

plugins.name: theme-pip-grid
plugins.description: Theme: black grid, full-frame diagrams, speaker in a round picture-in-picture bubble, gradient-wipe captions.

plugins.name: theme-editor-light
plugins.description: Theme: butter-yellow grid, light code editor with typed snippets, background-removed speaker sticker, highlighter captions.

plugins.name: theme-launch-promo
plugins.description: Theme: product promo reels, talking head plus real screen recordings with zoom, pan and speed-up, brand reveal and comment CTA.

plugins.name: theme-noir-red
plugins.description: Theme: cinematic black and red, full-screen intro, icon-driven system-design diagrams on a glowing card, speaker window framed hair to mic.

plugins.name: theme-festive-ops
plugins.description: Theme: light grey blueprint with sale orange and app blue, notification-toast captions, phone mockups and push toasts, logo inline with the title.

plugins.name: theme-saffron-ledger
plugins.description: Theme: cream paper with saffron and India green, stamped cards, receipt captions, Phosphor icons, official logos inline with the title (fintech, payments).

plugins.name: theme-chat-wall
plugins.description: Theme: messenger look, doodle chat wallpaper, teal bars, chat-bubble captions with ticks, phone mockups, cut-out speaker.

plugins.name: theme-void-index
plugins.description: Theme: list and countdown reels, near-black with blue, cyan and brown glow, progress rail, countdown ring scaled to the list, item cards, cut-out speaker.

plugins.name: theme-ticket-red
plugins.description: Theme: event ticketing look, whitish paper with ticket red, perforated ticket cards, seat maps, ticket-stub captions, cut-out speaker.

plugins.name: theme-sketchbook
plugins.description: Theme: notebook explainer with hard cuts between the speaker (real background) and full-screen hand-drawn pages, handwriting, highlighter captions, lo-fi music.

plugins.name: theme-receipt-tape
plugins.description: Theme: dark desk explainer with hard cuts between the speaker (real background) and full-screen pages of printing receipt slips, data-file cards, stamps and blackouts, ambient electronic music.

plugins.name: theme-packet-lab
plugins.description: Theme: light network-lab explainer with hard cuts between the speaker (real background) and full-screen pages of devices, travelling packets, HTTP/JSON code panels and a step tracker, minimal house music.

plugins.name: theme-dotgrid-dark
plugins.description: Theme: black dot-grid explainer with hard cuts between the speaker (real background) and full-screen pages of thread lanes, callback queues, code panels and an event-loop ring, dark techno music.

plugins.name: theme-orange-board
plugins.description: Theme: whiteboard explainer with an orange dot grid and hard cuts between the speaker (real background) and full-screen pages of white cards, connectors, token streams and code panels, chill-trap music.

plugins.name: reel-classic
plugins.description: The original Python pipeline: split-panel (diagram over a black top) and full-screen (cut-out speaker) modes.
